Mind you, I'm not going to help you with blowing up the place, but it sure will keep me warm at night knowing they got their just desserts for snubbing me.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Rori}}</ref>}}
The '''Hyperdrive Research Facility''' was a research facility of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

==History==
{{Quote|I used to work on making some real fine hyperdrives for them, but then they went off and bought my company right out from under me. That place used to be mine, and I swear I'm not going to see it owned by anyone else!|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac" />}}
The Hyperdrive Research Facility was home to some of the top [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] research in the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:HRF" /> It was originally a Rorian company that manufactured hyperdrive systems for the Galactic Empire. However, at some point, the Empire decided to buy the facility and forced its owner to sell the company.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the facility was staffed by a number of Imperial forces, including [[Stormrifle|stormtrooper riflemen]] and a [[Brigadier]] General.<ref name="SWG:HRF" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Imperial Hyperdrive Research Facility had become a contested hotspot in the Galactic Civil War and Imperial and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces fought several times for the control of the facility. Rebel forces managed to capture the facility several times but Imperial forces had always taken it back.<ref name="StW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hyperdrive Research Facility was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:HRF" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update on [[August 3]], 2003,<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref> the Imperial Stronghold was turned into a "Factional NPC Base". Groups of Rebel players could attack Imperial NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW" />
